Mission Local’s short “People We Meet” piece followed three friends who arrived at the GameStop on Mission Street at 6 a.m. to get “The Legend of Zelda: Tears of the Kingdom.” They brought folding chairs and worked remotely while they waited for the store to open. The three got the first spots in line for collector’s editions.
